description: Main window: the user interface only subscribes to the app's events and ends that again (ui/api/tauri.ts: listen, unlisten). The app's own commands and the channels of their streamed answers and progress need no permission: the app defines no ACL manifest for its commands, and Tauri does not check the channel's fetch command. Not allowed: emitting events from the webview (emit, emit_to), path resolution, images, menus, tray, windows, webviews and the app plugin. File dialogs and opening files run in Rust. app/tests/capabilities.rs guards this list.
